cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是BBC世界服务部的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Charlotte Gallagher, and at 1400 hours GMT on Tuesday, 15 September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是夏洛特·加拉格尔。以下是格林尼治标准时间9月15日星期二14时的主要新闻。

cues.en: As Ukraine and Russia continue fighting, Kyiv says it's ready to observe a temporary pause in attacks on energy infrastructure.
cues.zh: 俄乌战事仍在继续，基辅方面表示，愿暂时停止袭击能源基础设施。

cues.en: In Lithuania, a NATO fighter jet shoots down a drone that entered the country's airspace.
cues.zh: 在立陶宛，一架北约战机击落了一架进入该国领空的无人机。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, Kenya will host the World Athletics Championships, a first for an African nation.
cues.zh: 本期还将报道：肯尼亚将举办世界田径锦标赛，这将是非洲国家首次承办。

cues.en: Nairobi has shown emphatically that this is their moment to supercharge the development of our sport in Kenya and across Africa.
cues.zh: 内罗毕有力地证明，现在正是推动肯尼亚乃至整个非洲田径运动飞速发展的时刻。

cues.en: And the number of people in Japan aged 100 or older has surpassed 100,000 for the first time.
cues.zh: 日本百岁及以上人口首次超过10万人。

cues.en: Fighting between Russia and Ukraine continues, despite Trump's claim that both sides would temporarily stop targeting critical infrastructure.
cues.zh: 俄乌之间的战斗并未暂停，尽管特朗普总统声称双方将暂时停止打击关键基础设施。

cues.en: Russia says a gas pipeline in the country's south was hit in an overnight attack.
cues.zh: 俄罗斯称，俄南部一条天然气管道在夜间袭击中遭到破坏。

cues.en: In Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region, officials said Russian attacks disrupted power supplies in some areas, and a petrol station in Kyiv was hit.
cues.zh: 乌克兰扎波罗热地区官员称，俄军袭击导致部分地区供电中断，基辅一座加油站也遭到袭击。

cues.en: Ukraine says it supports de-escalation, but only if Russia shows it's ready to end the war.
cues.zh: 乌克兰表示支持局势降级，但前提是俄罗斯展现出结束战争的意愿。

cues.en: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said Ukraine was ready for a ceasefire.
cues.zh: 外交部长安德里·瑟比哈表示，乌克兰已准备好停火。

cues.en: Ukraine is ready for such a ceasefire. Our partners know our position.
cues.zh: 乌克兰已准备好接受这样的停火。我们的伙伴了解我们的立场。

cues.en: There are several other proposals from our closest and international partners.
cues.zh: 我们最亲密的伙伴以及国际伙伴还提出了其他几项方案。

cues.en: They aim to make progress on this track and, through joint efforts, achieve an energy ceasefire.
cues.zh: 这些方案旨在推动相关进程，通过共同努力实现能源停火。

cues.en: The Kremlin welcomed the US proposal but added that what it called illegal sanctions on Russian energy supplies should be lifted.
cues.zh: 克里姆林宫称欢迎美国的提议，但补充说，应解除其所谓针对俄罗斯能源供应的非法制裁。

cues.en: Our correspondent James Landale is in the Ukrainian capital and told me more about the overnight attacks.
cues.zh: 本台记者詹姆斯·兰代尔在乌克兰首都，为我进一步介绍夜间袭击情况。

cues.en: Here in Kyiv, yet again, there were more air raids and more Russian drones in the skies overnight.
cues.zh: 基辅这里昨夜再度响起空袭警报，空中又出现了更多俄罗斯无人机。

cues.en: This morning, our understanding is that the main targets of those drones were petrol stations.
cues.zh: 据我们了解，今天早上这些无人机的主要目标是加油站。

cues.en: Two were hit. We know a number of people were injured, and there is a report that one has now died of their wounds in hospital.
cues.zh: 两座加油站遭到袭击。我们知道有多人受伤，据报其中一人后来在医院因伤势过重去世。

cues.en: This is part of a continuing pattern: Russia is increasingly choosing petrol stations as targets in a wider escalation of its attacks against Ukraine.
cues.zh: 这已成为持续出现的模式：俄罗斯越来越多地把加油站作为目标，进一步扩大对乌克兰的袭击。

cues.en: In turn, we know of a Ukrainian missile attack on a town in southern Russia, on the Sea of Azov.
cues.zh: 另一方面，据了解，乌克兰导弹袭击了俄罗斯南部亚速海沿岸的一座城镇。

cues.en: The local regional governor reported Ukrainian strikes on a warehouse and a gas pipeline. So the fighting continues.
cues.zh: 当地州长报告称，乌克兰袭击了一处仓库和一条天然气管道。战斗仍在继续。

cues.en: Have Ukraine and Russia said anything about the temporary pause Donald Trump announced on targeting critical infrastructure?
cues.zh: 对于唐纳德·特朗普宣布的暂停打击关键基础设施，俄乌双方有什么回应吗？

cues.en: Well, Donald Trump said there was an agreement. That's not true. What there is is some kind of proposal doing the rounds.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普称双方达成了协议。事实并非如此。目前流传的是某种提议。

cues.en: In an overnight address, President Zelensky welcomed what he called a strong US proposal for a pause in attacks on critical infrastructure.
cues.zh: 泽连斯基总统在夜间讲话中表示，他欢迎美国提出的、他所称的暂停袭击关键基础设施的有力提议。

cues.en: He said Ukraine was, in principle, willing to de-escalate.
cues.zh: 他说，原则上乌克兰愿意缓和局势。

cues.en: But they would do so only if there were a very genuine and clear sign that Russia was ready to end the war.
cues.zh: 但只有在俄罗斯明确、真诚地展现出结束战争的意愿时，他们才会这样做。

cues.en: He said that, at the moment, there isn't such readiness.
cues.zh: 他说，目前俄罗斯并没有这样的意愿。

cues.en: Here, not many people are holding their breath for any kind of pause in the fighting.
cues.zh: 在这里，没多少人对战斗会暂停抱有期待。

cues.en: The general expectation is that Russia will try to use the coming winter to put as much pressure as it can on Ukraine.
cues.zh: 普遍预期是，俄罗斯会试图利用即将到来的冬季，尽可能向乌克兰施压。

cues.en: That was James Landale in Kyiv.
cues.zh: 以上是基辅的詹姆斯·兰代尔发回的报道。

cues.en: On Monday, NATO and EU leaders condemned what they described as Russian attempts to frighten the West away from supporting Ukraine.
cues.zh: 周一，北约和欧盟领导人谴责他们所称的俄罗斯企图恐吓西方、使其不再支持乌克兰的行为。

cues.en: This followed a drone striking a train near the Ukraine–Poland border.
cues.zh: 此前，一架无人机击中了乌克兰与波兰边境附近的一列火车。

cues.en: Less than 24 hours later, NATO said one of its fighter jets had shot down a drone that entered Lithuanian airspace.
cues.zh: 不到24小时后，北约称其一架战机击落了一架进入立陶宛领空的无人机。

cues.en: Deividas Matulionis is the national security adviser to Lithuania's president.
cues.zh: 戴维达斯·马图利奥尼斯是立陶宛总统的国家安全顾问。

cues.en: This is a serious, significant violation of our airspace, and this isn't the first time we've encountered such a threat.
cues.zh: 这是对我国领空的严重侵犯，我们也并非首次遭遇这种威胁。

cues.en: And where it comes from, difficult to say,
cues.zh: 至于它来自哪里，很难说，

cues.en: but originally the route of the flight was from Belarus.
cues.zh: 但这架无人机最初的飞行路线来自白俄罗斯。

cues.en: And what type of drone, we cannot say.
cues.zh: 至于无人机的类型，我们无法确定。

cues.en: Is it intentional or just diverted from the initial route? Now, an investigation is under way.
cues.zh: 这是蓄意为之，还是偏离了原定路线？目前调查正在进行。

cues.en: Our correspondent, Sarah Rainsford, was in the Lithuanian capital, Vilnius, when the drone incursion happened.
cues.zh: 无人机闯入领空时，本台记者莎拉·雷恩斯福德正在立陶宛首都维尔纽斯。

cues.en: It was just after midnight this morning here in Vilnius that my phone screeched with an alert.
cues.zh: 今天凌晨刚过午夜，我在维尔纽斯的手机突然尖锐地响起警报。

cues.en: And when I checked the message, it said there was a suspected drone.
cues.zh: 我查看消息时，上面说发现了一架疑似无人机。

cues.en: Keep safe, it said, and wait for the all clear.
cues.zh: 消息说：“注意安全，等待解除警报。”

cues.en: Now, that all clear came about 20 minutes later,
cues.zh: 大约20分钟后，解除警报的通知传来，

cues.en: and we now know that a drone was confirmed in Lithuanian airspace,
cues.zh: 现在我们得知，确认有一架无人机进入了立陶宛领空，

cues.en: for around half an hour before it was intercepted and shot down by NATO fighter jets.
cues.zh: 它在领空内停留了约半小时，之后被北约战斗机拦截并击落。

cues.en: We still don't know who that drone belonged to.
cues.zh: 我们仍不知道这架无人机属于谁。

cues.en: We don't know whether it was launched deliberately or might have strayed into Lithuanian airspace.
cues.zh: 我们不知道它是被蓄意放飞，还是可能偏入了立陶宛领空。

cues.en: We know that it entered from neighbouring Belarus, and after it was shot down, the debris was scattered over a wide area,
cues.zh: 我们知道它从邻国白俄罗斯进入；被击落后，残骸散落在大片区域，

cues.en: so it's being collected and examined to see who it was launched by,
cues.zh: 目前正收集并检查残骸，以查明是谁发射了它，

cues.en: and whether or not it was armed—in fact, whether there were any explosives.
cues.zh: 并确认它是否携带武器，具体来说，是否装有爆炸物。

cues.en: But this has happened at a nervous time here in this region,
cues.zh: 不过，这件事发生在本地区局势紧张之时，

cues.en: because Russia is escalating its full-scale war on Ukraine and also its hybrid attacks on Ukraine's greatest supporters.
cues.zh: 因为俄罗斯正在加剧对乌克兰的全面战争，也在升级针对乌克兰最坚定支持者的混合攻击。

cues.en: Vilnius, Lithuania, has always been a staunch supporter of Ukraine, ever since the full-scale invasion.
cues.zh: 自全面入侵以来，立陶宛首都维尔纽斯一直坚定支持乌克兰。

cues.en: This city is still covered in Ukrainian flags. There are lots of messages of solidarity.
cues.zh: 这座城市仍处处可见乌克兰国旗，也有许多声援信息。

cues.en: In the past, when there have been drone incursions into other countries, including Poland and other Baltic states,
cues.zh: 过去无人机闯入其他国家领空时，包括波兰和其他波罗的海国家，

cues.en: experts have suggested that Moscow could be testing NATO's reactions.
cues.zh: 专家曾推测，莫斯科可能是在试探北约的反应。

cues.en: For now, there are more questions than answers here in Lithuania,
cues.zh: 目前在立陶宛，仍然是疑问多于答案，

cues.en: but certainly there is now a full-scale investigation into what happened and who might be behind it. That was Sarah Rainsford.
cues.zh: 但现在确实已就事件经过及幕后可能涉及何方展开全面调查。莎拉·雷恩斯福德报道。

cues.en: Saudi Arabia has vowed to respond firmly to attacks by Yemen's Houthis,
cues.zh: 沙特阿拉伯誓言坚决回应也门胡塞武装的袭击，

cues.en: after the Iran-backed fighters wounded 13 people in the south of the kingdom in an assault using ballistic missiles and drones.
cues.zh: 此前，受伊朗支持的武装人员使用弹道导弹和无人机发动袭击，造成沙特南部13人受伤。

cues.en: In Yemen, reports on a Houthi-run media outlet say three people were killed in Saudi-led airstrikes.
cues.zh: 也门方面，胡塞武装运营的媒体报道称，沙特领导的空袭造成3人死亡。

cues.en: The recent fighting has been some of the heaviest in the region in years,
cues.zh: 近来的战斗是该地区多年来最激烈的一次，

cues.en: forcing thousands of civilians to flee across the Red Sea to neighbouring Djibouti.
cues.zh: 迫使数千名平民逃过红海，前往邻国吉布提。

cues.en: Ramatou Touré is the representative in Djibouti for the United Nations Children's Agency, UNICEF.
cues.zh: 拉马图·图雷是联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）驻吉布提代表。

cues.en: She spoke to my colleague Anne Soy about what she'd witnessed.
cues.zh: 她向我的同事安妮·索伊讲述了自己的所见。

cues.en: What we've been witnessing is the arrival of civilians crossing the Red Sea,
cues.zh: 我们看到的是平民渡过红海陆续抵达，

cues.en: and families and women on boats who have arrived in Djibouti, where they've been received by the government.
cues.zh: 船上有家庭和妇女抵达吉布提，并受到吉布提政府接待。

cues.en: So we've been seeing at least 2,400 people crossing over the past few days.
cues.zh: 过去几天，我们看到至少有2,400人渡海而来。

cues.en: We estimate that half of them are children.
cues.zh: 我们估计其中一半是儿童。

cues.en: They are tired, but they are also very relieved once they arrive.
cues.zh: 他们很疲惫，但抵达后也感到如释重负。

cues.en: What we've seen is families crossing.
cues.zh: 我们看到家庭正在渡海。

cues.en: We've also seen children who had to cross in different boats.
cues.zh: 我们还看到有些孩子不得不乘不同的船只渡海。

cues.en: What do you expect in the coming days and weeks if the situation does not improve?
cues.zh: 如果局势没有好转，你预计未来几天和几周会怎样？

cues.en: Well, first of all, I think we were all kind of surprised by the numbers.
cues.zh: 嗯，首先，我想我们都对这些数字有些意外。

cues.en: We do not know, obviously, how the situation will evolve, but we are expecting more arrivals.
cues.zh: 显然，我们不知道局势将如何发展，但预计还会有更多人抵达。

cues.en: We are planning for 5,000 to 10,000.
cues.zh: 我们的规划规模是5,000至10,000人。

cues.en: I would say it will be difficult for us, as partners, to provide assistance to these arrivals.
cues.zh: 我想说，作为合作伙伴，我们要为这些抵达者提供援助会很困难。

cues.en: First, they need water, shelter and food; the government is providing assistance.
cues.zh: 他们首先需要水、住所和食物，目前由政府提供援助。

cues.en: Should the situation escalate, it will be very difficult to cover those needs.
cues.zh: 如果局势升级，满足这些需求将非常困难。

cues.en: Presumably, the ones who have arrived, the 2,400, they don't expect to be leaving anytime soon.
cues.zh: 想必已抵达的这2,400人并不认为自己很快就能离开。

cues.en: Do you have enough to provide for them?
cues.zh: 你们有足够的资源来帮助他们吗？

cues.en: Definitely not. There's definitely not.
cues.zh: 肯定不够，肯定不够。

cues.en: So we need to plan both for new arrivals,
cues.zh: 所以我们既要为新抵达者做计划，

cues.en: but also how are we going to support the government?
cues.zh: 也要考虑如何支持政府。

cues.en: The good thing is that they are actually arriving in a refugee village called Markazi,
cues.zh: 好在他们抵达了名为 Markazi 的难民村，

cues.en: where there are some basic facilities already, but this is not enough.
cues.zh: 那里已经有一些基本设施，但仍远远不够。

cues.en: We urgently need additional assistance.
cues.zh: 我们急需更多援助。

cues.en: As for UNICEF alone, we are planning and we have a need of 3 million US dollars to cover for 10,000 people.
cues.zh: 仅联合国儿童基金会就计划筹集300万美元，以覆盖10,000人的需求。

cues.en: As we say, this is our estimate for the next six months.
cues.zh: 正如我们所说，这是我们对未来六个月的估算。

cues.en: Kenya has a long history of producing some of the world's greatest athletes, especially in long-distance running.
cues.zh: 肯尼亚长期以来培养出许多世界顶尖运动员，尤其擅长长跑。

cues.en: Now it will become the first African country to host the World Athletics Championships, in 2029.
cues.zh: 如今，肯尼亚将成为首个主办世界田径锦标赛的非洲国家，赛事定于2029年举行。

cues.en: World Athletics President Sebastian Coe made the announcement.
cues.zh: 世界田径联合会主席塞巴斯蒂安·科宣布了这一消息。

cues.en: It was important for the World Championships to come to Africa,
cues.zh: 让世界田径锦标赛来到非洲很重要，

cues.en: when we had the right host, the right bid and the right circumstances.
cues.zh: 前提是找到合适的主办方、合适的申办方案和合适的时机。

cues.en: Nairobi has shown emphatically that this is its moment to supercharge the development of the sport in Kenya and across Africa.
cues.zh: 内罗毕已明确展现，这是推动肯尼亚乃至整个非洲田径运动发展的好时机。

cues.en: Nairobi beat bids from London and Rome.
cues.zh: 内罗毕击败了伦敦和罗马的申办。

cues.en: Our Global Affairs reporter Richard Kagoye is in the Kenyan capital to explain why Kenya came out on top.
cues.zh: 本台全球事务记者理查德·卡戈耶在肯尼亚首都，为我们介绍肯尼亚胜出的原因。

cues.en: Kenya put forward a very solid and emotional bid to host this historic event.
cues.zh: 肯尼亚为主办这项历史性赛事提交了一份非常扎实、也很打动人的申办方案。

cues.en: Kenyans really follow athletics. It is the country's second most-followed sport, after football.
cues.zh: 肯尼亚人确实热爱田径。它是该国关注度第二高的运动，仅次于足球。

cues.en: Kenyans are also highly engaged with athletics online and on social media.
cues.zh: 肯尼亚人在网上和社交媒体上也非常关注田径。

cues.en: Kenya has produced world and Olympic champions over the years,
cues.zh: 多年来，肯尼亚培养了世界冠军和奥运冠军，

cues.en: so hosting the event for the first time on the African continent will be a historic moment for the country.
cues.zh: 因此，首次在非洲大陆举办这项赛事将成为肯尼亚的历史性时刻。

cues.en: What's the reaction in Kenya? It must feel like this has been a long time coming.
cues.zh: 肯尼亚国内反应如何？人们一定觉得这一天已经等了很久。

cues.en: Absolutely, you're right. Kenya bid for 2025, but lost out to Tokyo.
cues.zh: 确实如此。肯尼亚曾申办2025年赛事，但输给了东京。

cues.en: There's been a lot of excitement, especially over President William Ruto's comment that this is Kenya's moment.
cues.zh: 人们非常兴奋，尤其是总统威廉·鲁托所说的“这是肯尼亚的时刻”。

cues.en: It's Africa's moment too. He calls it a victory for generations of athletes who made their nation renowned.
cues.zh: 这也是非洲的时刻。他说，这是对一代代运动员的肯定；他们让国家享有盛誉。

cues.en: Their excellence shines on the track, the road and in cross-country.
cues.zh: 他们在田径场、公路和越野赛中都表现卓越。

cues.en: Comments also came from Kenyan sprinter Ferdinand Omanyala, the African 100-metre record holder.
cues.zh: 非洲男子百米纪录保持者、肯尼亚短跑选手费迪南德·奥曼亚拉也发表了看法。

cues.en: “What a time to be a Kenyan athlete.”
cues.zh: “做一名肯尼亚运动员，真是恰逢其时。”

cues.en: And Paul Tergat, as you may remember, said Kenya truly deserved this chance to host the event.
cues.zh: 保罗·特尔加特也表示，肯尼亚确实值得获得主办这项赛事的机会。

cues.en: So this is seen as a victory for Africa, not just Kenya,
cues.zh: 所以，这被视为非洲的胜利，而不只是肯尼亚的胜利，

cues.en: because athletics is growing across East Africa—in Tanzania, Uganda and as far as South Africa.
cues.zh: 因为田径运动正在东非各地发展，从坦桑尼亚、乌干达到南非皆是如此。

cues.en: It's a moment of pride for the continent.
cues.zh: 这是整个非洲大陆引以为傲的时刻。

cues.en: What will happen with Nairobi's infrastructure? Will they build new stadiums or upgrade older ones?
cues.zh: 内罗毕的基础设施接下来会怎样？他们会新建体育场，还是升级旧场馆？

cues.en: For now, the plan is mainly to upgrade. Work has been under way for a while,
cues.zh: 目前主要计划是升级改造。相关工作已经开展了一段时间，

cues.en: as Kenya is also set to host the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations with Uganda and Tanzania.
cues.zh: 因为肯尼亚还将与乌干达和坦桑尼亚共同主办2027年非洲国家杯。

cues.en: The city's biggest stadium has about 48,000 seats.
cues.zh: 这座城市最大的体育场约有4.8万个座位。

cues.en: It's undergoing a major structural overhaul and renovation for the football event and the athletics championships.
cues.zh: 它正在进行大规模结构改造和翻新，以迎接足球赛事和田径锦标赛。

cues.en: Another city stadium has roughly 30,000 seats,
cues.zh: 城里另一座体育场大约有3万个座位，

cues.en: about half the size. It is also being renovated, with more major work planned, but it has no running track.
cues.zh: 规模约为一半。它也在翻新，后续还有大型工程，但没有跑道。

cues.en: The country has been positioning itself for major sporting events locally, regionally and internationally.
cues.zh: 肯尼亚一直在为举办本国、区域乃至国际大型体育赛事作准备。

cues.en: With 2029 still ahead, they have some lead time.
cues.zh: 距离2029年还有一段时间，他们仍有准备余地。

cues.en: That was Richard Kagoye.
cues.zh: 理查德·卡戈耶的报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast.
cues.zh: 本节目稍后还有更多内容。

cues.en: Read early in childhood, and as an adolescent you have better brain structure,
cues.zh: 如果从小开始阅读，到了青春期，大脑结构会更好，

cues.en: better cognition, stronger academic performance and less inattention.
cues.zh: 认知能力更强，学业表现更好，也更不容易注意力不集中。

cues.en: Why reading—whatever the genre—can bring health benefits at every stage of life.
cues.zh: 为什么阅读能在人生各个阶段带来健康益处？读什么类型的作品都可以。

cues.en: This is the Global News podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Japan now has more than 100,000 people aged 100 or older for the first time,
cues.zh: 日本百岁及以上人口首次超过10万人，

cues.en: and the vast majority are women.
cues.zh: 其中绝大多数是女性。

cues.en: The oldest person is 114 years old, and she's a woman in Kyoto.
cues.zh: 最年长者是一位居住在京都的女性，今年114岁。

cues.en: I asked our Tokyo correspondent, Kurumi Mori, why so many Japanese people live for so long.
cues.zh: 我问了本台东京记者森久留美，为什么这么多日本人如此长寿。

cues.en: I mean, there's no single explanation for this.
cues.zh: 这件事没有单一的解释。

cues.en: But Japan's longevity is probably the result of several factors working together over the past few decades.
cues.zh: 不过，日本人的长寿很可能是过去几十年来多种因素共同作用的结果。

cues.en: The number-one factor I see here on the ground is perhaps the diet: traditional Japanese food.
cues.zh: 我在当地看到的首要因素或许是饮食，也就是传统的日本料理。

cues.en: It's often associated with more fish, vegetables and rice—relatively nutritious foods.
cues.zh: 传统饮食通常包含更多鱼类、蔬菜和米饭，营养也相对丰富。

cues.en: Historically, Japan has had lower levels of saturated fat than many Western diets.
cues.zh: 历史上，日本饮食中的饱和脂肪含量低于许多西方饮食。

cues.en: That may be one contributing factor.
cues.zh: 这或许是其中一个因素。

cues.en: Another factor is healthcare. Japan has a highly developed system that gives broad access to medical care.
cues.zh: 另一个因素是医疗保健。日本的医疗体系高度发达，医疗服务覆盖面广。

cues.en: Care is available at a reasonable cost, helping prevent illnesses, detect them and treat them.
cues.zh: 人们能以相当合理的费用获得医疗服务，从而预防、发现并治疗疾病。

cues.en: There are lifestyle factors too. Physical activity is very important in Japan.
cues.zh: 生活方式也是因素之一。体育活动在日本非常普遍。

cues.en: Many social connections and communities are built around staying engaged, which may also contribute to healthy ageing.
cues.zh: 许多社会联系和社区活动都鼓励人们保持参与，这也可能有助于健康老龄化。

cues.en: These figures are going up and up as well.
cues.zh: 这些数字也在不断上升。

cues.en: When they began counting in the 1960s, the number was relatively small; now, as you say, it has passed 100,000.
cues.zh: 我看到，20世纪60年代开始统计时人数还很少；如今，正如你所说，已经超过10万。

cues.en: That's right. When the government began compiling the figure in 1963, there were only 153 centenarians.
cues.zh: 没错。政府从1963年开始统计时，百岁老人只有153人。

cues.en: That number has now surpassed 100,000, as you said.
cues.zh: 正如你所说，如今人数已超过10万。

cues.en: The figure has risen every year for the past 56 years and keeps going up.
cues.zh: 过去56年来，这一数字年年增长，而且还在不断上升。

cues.en: The striking part is that 88% of all centenarians are women.
cues.zh: 引人注目的是，所有百岁老人中有88%是女性。

cues.en: That's the same figure reported last year, in 2025: 88% of them were women.
cues.zh: 这与去年，也就是2025年公布的数据相同：女性占88%。

cues.en: All this is happening while Japan's overall population is declining.
cues.zh: 这一切都发生在日本总人口不断减少的同时。

cues.en: It seems that avoiding isolation and staying involved in the community may matter as much as diet and healthcare.
cues.zh: 看来，不与社会隔绝、积极参与社区，或许和饮食及医疗保健同样重要。

cues.en: Yes, there's a lot of research, and it's ongoing.
cues.zh: 是的，相关研究很多，而且仍在持续进行。

cues.en: Some experts suggest that combining good healthcare with healthy lifestyles helps.
cues.zh: 一些专家认为，将良好的医疗保健与健康的生活方式结合起来会有帮助。

cues.en: Managing illnesses early can really contribute to longevity in Japan.
cues.zh: 及早管理疾病确实有助于日本人长寿。

cues.en: There is also a cautionary tale for Japan, right? Longer lives combined with very low birth rates create a shrinking workforce.
cues.zh: 日本也面临一个令人警醒的问题，对吧？寿命延长加上极低出生率，会导致劳动力萎缩。

cues.en: That's putting pressure on society as well.
cues.zh: 这也给社会带来了压力。

cues.en: That was Kurumi Mori in Tokyo.
cues.zh: 以上是东京记者森久留美的报道。

cues.en: The Emmys, one of television's biggest nights, have taken place in Los Angeles, recognising the year's hit shows.
cues.zh: 电视界年度盛事之一艾美奖颁奖礼在洛杉矶举行，表彰过去一年的热门剧集。

cues.en: Widow's Bay, a comedy-horror series about a sleepy, supposedly cursed New England town, completely dominated the awards.
cues.zh: 喜剧恐怖剧《Widow's Bay》讲述新英格兰一座沉寂且据称遭诅咒的小镇，并在颁奖礼上大获全胜。

cues.en: It was followed by the emergency-room drama, The Pitt.
cues.zh: 紧随其后的是急诊室题材剧《The Pitt》。

cues.en: The Welsh actor Matthew Rhys also made history, winning two lead acting prizes.
cues.zh: 威尔士演员马修·瑞斯也创造了历史，赢得两个主角表演奖。

cues.en: The celebrations will be long, varied, and—and I hope at times wild.
cues.zh: 庆祝活动会持续很久，形式多样——我希望有时也会很热烈。

cues.en: It's incredible. It really—it certainly hasn't sunk in. I'm stumbling for words because I really don't have them at the moment.
cues.zh: 这太不可思议了。我真的——这件事确实还没让我缓过神来。我都语无伦次了，此刻实在不知该说什么。

cues.en: I can't. I really can't quite believe it.
cues.zh: 我不敢相信。我真的不敢相信这一切。

cues.en: I'm from a small country, and I'm glad we get moments to put our flag on the map.
cues.zh: 我来自一个小国，很高兴我们有机会把威尔士的旗帜插上世界地图。

cues.en: And say we sometimes punch above our weight in Wales.
cues.zh: 并让大家看到威尔士有时能以小博大。

cues.en: For outstanding writing for a comedy series, Katie Dippold also won the prize for Widow's Bay.
cues.zh: 在喜剧类最佳编剧奖中，凯蒂·迪波德也凭《Widow's Bay》获奖。

cues.en: Here she is explaining how she works.
cues.zh: 下面听听她介绍自己的创作方式。

cues.en: A lot of it is just following your gut, you know.
cues.zh: 很多时候，就是跟着直觉走，你知道吧。

cues.en: Sometimes something feels right for a comedic moment, and sometimes you don't want to undercut the tension or scare with something silly.
cues.zh: 有时某个桥段很适合喜剧效果；有时你又不想用滑稽的东西削弱紧张感或破坏恐怖氛围。

cues.en: So it's truly just trial and error, feeling your way through.
cues.zh: 所以这完全就是不断尝试、摸索着往前走。

cues.en: Even during production, there are times when we look at each other and ask:
cues.zh: 即使在制作过程中，我们有时也会面面相觑，问彼此：

cues.en: Does this feel weird? Does it feel right? Weird? Then adjust.
cues.zh: 这样会不会很奇怪？感觉对吗？不对劲？那就调整。

cues.en: So it's truly just trial and error, then seeing what comes together.
cues.zh: 所以确实就是不断试错，再看看最后能组合出什么。

cues.en: And here's our correspondent in LA, David Willis, with a roundup of the night.
cues.zh: 下面请洛杉矶记者戴维·威利斯为我们回顾颁奖之夜。

cues.en: It's the annual Emmy Awards show, with prizes for comedy, drama, reality and late-night television.
cues.zh: 这是一年一度的艾美奖颁奖礼，奖项涵盖喜剧、剧情、真人秀和深夜电视节目。

cues.en: Law & Order star Mariska Hargitay kicked off the proceedings with a song.
cues.zh: 《法律与秩序》演员玛莉丝卡·哈吉塔以一首歌拉开颁奖礼序幕。

cues.en: Sally Field paid tribute to Dolly Parton, saying the world had, in her words, “lost an angel.”
cues.zh: 莎莉·菲尔德向多莉·帕顿致敬，并引用她的话说，世界“失去了一位天使”。

cues.en: Michael J. Fox received multiple standing ovations.
cues.zh: 迈克尔·J·福克斯多次获得全场起立鼓掌。

cues.en: And a rare humanitarian award for his charitable work on behalf of Parkinson's disease.
cues.zh: 他还因支持帕金森病慈善事业获颁罕见的人道主义奖。

cues.en: But the night belonged to the quirky new horror comedy Widow's Bay,
cues.zh: 不过，当晚的焦点属于这部新颖又古怪的恐怖喜剧《寡妇湾》，

cues.en: which broke the comedy-series record with 14 Emmys, including best comedy and three acting awards.
cues.zh: 它以14项艾美奖打破喜剧类剧集纪录，包括最佳喜剧和三项表演奖。

cues.en: The show's star, Welsh actor Matthew Rhys, made history by winning two lead-acting prizes in one night
cues.zh: 该剧主演、威尔士演员马修·瑞斯创造了历史，一晚拿下两项主演奖，

cues.en: for Widow's Bay and The Beast in Me, a Netflix limited series.
cues.zh: 分别凭借《寡妇湾》和网飞限定剧《兽性本我》获奖。

cues.en: Widow's Bay won 14 Emmys in total, breaking the record for a comedy series,
cues.zh: 《寡妇湾》共获14项艾美奖，打破喜剧类剧集纪录，

cues.en: including best supporting actress for Kate O'Flynn as the awkward assistant Patricia.
cues.zh: 其中包括凯特·奥弗林凭借饰演笨拙的助理帕特里夏获得最佳女配角。

cues.en: The other big winner was medical drama The Pitt, which won six Emmys, including best lead actor.
cues.zh: 另一部大赢家是医疗剧《匹兹堡医魂》，共获六项艾美奖，包括最佳男主角。

cues.en: That prize went to Noah Wyle.
cues.zh: 该奖项由诺亚·怀尔获得。

cues.en: Amid Hollywood's production decline and a flight to cheaper places like Canada and the UK, The Pitt offers a crumb of comfort.
cues.zh: 好莱坞制作量下滑，制作纷纷转往加拿大和英国等成本较低的地区；在此背景下，《匹兹堡医魂》至少带来一丝安慰。

cues.en: It was made not in Pittsburgh but on a soundstage in Los Angeles, and it's already been commissioned for a third series.
cues.zh: 该剧并非在匹兹堡拍摄，而是在洛杉矶的摄影棚制作；目前已获续订第三季。

cues.en: That was David Willis in LA.
cues.zh: 以上是大卫·威利斯在洛杉矶的报道。

cues.en: Cambridge University researchers say reading for pleasure is linked to better mental health, lower stress, and a reduced risk of dementia.
cues.zh: 剑桥大学研究人员表示，出于乐趣而阅读与更好的心理健康、较低的压力水平和较低的痴呆风险有关。

cues.en: In a new review of existing evidence, scientists argue that regularly picking up
cues.zh: 科学家在一项新的既有证据综述中指出，经常拿起

cues.en: a book, whatever the genre, can bring health benefits at every stage of life.
cues.zh: 一本书来读，无论是什么体裁，都能在人生各阶段带来健康益处。

cues.en: One study of more than 10,000 young people found that early readers had better concentration, memory, and problem-solving skills.
cues.zh: 一项针对一万多名年轻人的研究发现，从小为了乐趣而阅读的人，专注力、记忆力和解决问题的能力更强。

cues.en: Professor Barbara Sahakian is the lead researcher.
cues.zh: 首席研究员是芭芭拉·萨哈基安教授。

cues.en: People can benefit from reading at all ages, which is great.
cues.zh: 各个年龄段的人都能从阅读中受益，这很不错。

cues.en: But it's especially important in early childhood; some of our studies show
cues.zh: 但在幼儿时期尤其重要；我们的一些研究显示，

cues.en: that reading's benefits accrue when you're an adolescent.
cues.zh: 阅读的益处会在青少年时期显现。

cues.en: So if you read early as a child, by adolescence,
cues.zh: 所以，如果从小开始阅读，到了青春期，

cues.en: you have better brain structure, cognition and academic attainment, and less inattention.
cues.zh: 大脑结构、认知和学业表现会更好，注意力不集中也会减少。

cues.en: There are fewer symptoms of mental health problems, and you get all these benefits.
cues.zh: 心理健康问题的症状也会减少，并能获得这些益处。

cues.en: They also spend less time on screens, which many parents worry about, and sleep for longer.
cues.zh: 他们看屏幕的时间也更少——很多家长都很在意这一点——而且睡眠时间更长。

cues.en: All these things accrue in adolescence if you were an early reader in childhood.
cues.zh: 如果童年时就开始阅读，这些益处会在青春期逐渐显现。

cues.en: That can be one of the hardest things for parents: getting their children
cues.zh: 对家长来说，最难做到的事情之一可能就是让孩子

cues.en: to read, especially when so many screens can seem more tempting to them.
cues.zh: 阅读，尤其是周围有那么多对孩子更有吸引力的屏幕时。

cues.en: Yes. The important thing is reading for pleasure; it doesn't really matter what they read, as studies have shown.
cues.zh: 是的。关键在于享受阅读；正如研究所示，读什么其实并不重要。

cues.en: Even comic books or anything that interests them—sports, for example—
cues.zh: 即便是漫画或任何让他们感兴趣的内容，比如体育，

cues.en: football, fashion, or whatever they want to read,
cues.zh: 足球、时尚，或他们想读的任何内容，

cues.en: it's good to get them reading; they'll probably keep it up as a lifelong habit.
cues.zh: 让他们开始阅读是件好事，他们很可能会把它保持为终身习惯。

cues.en: At the other end of the spectrum, reading is also great for you; we reported on a couple of studies
cues.zh: 另一方面，阅读对年长者也很有益；我们报道过几项研究，

cues.en: involving a large group of about 2,000 older adults.
cues.zh: 其中一项涉及约两千名老年人。

cues.en: Those who read just once a week were less likely to suffer cognitive decline with ageing over 14 years.
cues.zh: 在14年间，每周只阅读一次的人出现认知衰退的可能性较低。

cues.en: That's great. Another study showed a 35% reduction in dementia risk if you were a reader,
cues.zh: 这很不错。另一项研究显示，阅读者患痴呆症的风险降低了35%，

cues.en: so at the other end of the spectrum you also gain a lot.
cues.zh: 所以在生命的另一端，阅读也能带来很多益处。

cues.en: Does it matter whether someone's reading a book or a magazine, or using a Kindle?
cues.zh: 读书或杂志，和用 Kindle 阅读，效果会有区别吗？

cues.en: Well, it does matter. Most people enjoy books more than Kindles, but Kindles are more practical.
cues.zh: 嗯，确实有区别。大多数人更喜欢纸质书，但 Kindle 更实用。

cues.en: But different effects occur in the brain depending on what you're reading.
cues.zh: 不过，读物不同，大脑受到的影响也不同。

cues.en: That was one of the most fascinating findings in the studies we looked at.
cues.zh: 这是我们研究中最引人入胜的发现之一。

cues.en: One study found that reading fiction with social content
cues.zh: 一项研究发现，阅读包含社会关系内容的小说，

cues.en: activated brain areas known to be involved in social cognition.
cues.zh: 会激活大脑中已知参与社会认知的区域。

cues.en: One such area is the temporoparietal junction.
cues.zh: 其中一个区域是颞顶联合区。

cues.en: This area is important for things like empathy or understanding other people's ideas,
cues.zh: 这个区域对共情或理解他人的想法等能力很重要，

cues.en: you know, theory of mind—what the other person is thinking.
cues.zh: 也就是所谓的心智理论：理解他人在想什么。

cues.en: And in surveys, when you ask people why they read, they say it's to reduce loneliness and connect more with others.
cues.zh: 调查中，人们说阅读能减少孤独感，让自己与他人建立更多联系。

cues.en: It also gives them more empathy and helps them understand things from another person's perspective.
cues.zh: 阅读也能增强共情，帮助人们从他人的角度理解事情。

cues.en: So it's really interesting that survey data fits very well with what we actually see in the brain when people are neuroimaged.
cues.zh: 因此，调查数据与脑部影像显示的结果高度吻合，这很有意思。

cues.en: That was Professor Barbara Sahakian.
cues.zh: 以上是芭芭拉·萨哈基安教授。

cues.en: Let's return to our main story and hear from Ukrainian tennis player Diana Yastremska, who's just finished playing in the US Open.
cues.zh: 回到我们的头条新闻，听听刚结束美国网球公开赛的乌克兰网球运动员达雅娜·雅斯特雷姆斯卡怎么说。

cues.en: Russian drones have carried out massive attacks in recent days. Her family home in the port city of Odessa, in the southwest, has also been hit.
cues.zh: 近几天，俄罗斯无人机发动大规模袭击；她位于乌克兰西南部港口城市敖德萨的家也遭到袭击。

cues.en: She's been speaking to the BBC's Rob Young about the moment she found out.
cues.zh: 她向 BBC 的罗布·扬讲述了自己得知此事的那一刻。

cues.en: I was in Nice. I woke at five in the morning to a video call from my father,
cues.zh: 我当时在尼斯。清晨五点，我被父亲打来的视频电话叫醒，

cues.en: and he told me a Russian Kalibr missile had hit our building in Odessa during the night.
cues.zh: 他告诉我，夜里一枚俄罗斯“口径”导弹击中了我们在敖德萨的楼房。

cues.en: Then they told me the apartment had been completely destroyed.
cues.zh: 后来他们告诉我，公寓已经彻底被毁。

cues.en: For the first few seconds, I couldn't really understand or realise what it meant.
cues.zh: 最初几秒，我真的无法理解，也没意识到这意味着什么。

cues.en: Some young men on the 21st floor were simply sleeping in their homes. They were killed.
cues.zh: 21楼有几名年轻男子当时只是在家里睡觉，却被杀害了。

cues.en: Another young man on the same floor was pulled out from underneath a concrete slab, and somehow he survived.
cues.zh: 同一楼层的另一名年轻男子被从混凝土板下救出，竟然活了下来。

cues.en: At that time, I thought I'd lost my apartment. But thank God my parents and my family are alive. It's very, very, very scary.
cues.zh: 当时我以为自己失去了公寓。但谢天谢地，父母和家人都还活着。这真的非常、非常、非常可怕。

cues.en: Now, you posted an image on social media of the bright orange Roland Garros towel hanging from the wreckage.
cues.zh: 你在社交媒体上发布了一张照片：一条亮橙色的罗兰·加洛斯毛巾挂在废墟上。

cues.en: Yeah. What's the significance of that?
cues.zh: 是的。那有什么特别意义？

cues.en: That's the only thing that was left, along with the white toy that was on the floor beneath the building.
cues.zh: 那是唯一留下的东西，还有一只在楼下地面上的白色玩具。

cues.en: And, you know, when I saw that towel—like, among the destruction—at first it almost didn't seem real,
cues.zh: 你知道，看到那条毛巾——在一片废墟之中——起初我几乎觉得这不是真的，

cues.en: because when there's nothing left, the only thing you see is the yellow towel at Roland Garros.
cues.zh: 因为周围一无所有时，你唯一看见的就是那条罗兰·加洛斯的黄色毛巾。

cues.en: You know, for someone, it's just a towel, but for me,
cues.zh: 你知道，对别人来说它只是一条毛巾，但对我而言，

cues.en: Roland Garros is my life, my journey, my dreams, my victories, my failures—my everything.
cues.zh: 罗兰·加洛斯就是我的人生、我的旅程、我的梦想、我的胜利、我的失利——我的一切。

cues.en: And at that time, when I saw it, it became a symbol for me.
cues.zh: 那一刻，当我看到它时，它成了一个象征。

cues.en: A symbol that the fight goes on, even when everything around has been destroyed.
cues.zh: 象征着即使周围的一切都已被毁，抗争仍在继续。

cues.en: Diana, it's Isaac, the sports presenter here. I'm really sorry to hear what's been happening to you and about your story.
cues.zh: 达雅娜，我是体育节目主持人艾萨克。听说你遭遇的这些事和你的经历，我真的很难过。

cues.en: I wondered: we're starting to see a bit of a thaw in relations between sporting bodies and Russian athletes.
cues.zh: 我想问问：体育组织与俄罗斯运动员之间的关系似乎开始有所缓和。

cues.en: And in July, the IOC said it would provisionally suspend the suspension on Russian athletes.
cues.zh: 我记得国际奥委会在7月表示，将暂时中止对俄罗斯运动员的禁令。

cues.en: I understand the WTA is a sports organisation. It cannot stop the war or make political decisions,
cues.zh: 我理解，女子网球协会是一个体育组织。它无法阻止战争，也不能作出政治决定，

cues.en: I would say, on behalf of governments.
cues.zh: 我想说，它不能代表各国政府作决定。

cues.en: And today, I don't really want to talk about who should or should not be allowed to compete in the tournaments.
cues.zh: 而今天，我不太想讨论谁应该或不应该获准参加这些赛事。

cues.en: For me, there is something more important right now.
cues.zh: 对我来说，现在有更重要的事情。

cues.en: For four and a half years, Ukrainian tennis players have been living and competing under circumstances
cues.zh: 四年半来，乌克兰网球运动员一直在这样的环境下生活和比赛，

cues.en: that are anything but normal.
cues.zh: 这种环境绝非正常。

cues.en: We step onto the same court, play by the same rules and are expected to deliver the same results.
cues.zh: 我们踏上同一片球场，遵守相同规则，也被期待取得相同成绩。

cues.en: But outside the court, our reality can be completely different.
cues.zh: 但在球场之外，我们的现实可能截然不同。

cues.en: We don't sleep well. We always worry about our family, about the people close to us.
cues.zh: 我们睡不好，总是担心家人，担心亲近的人。

cues.en: Like, that's why I would like the WTA to remember that behind every Ukrainian flag
cues.zh: 所以我希望女子网球协会记住，每一面乌克兰国旗背后，

cues.en: in a tournament draw, there's a real person, a family and a country where the war is still going on.
cues.zh: 在赛事签表中，都代表着一个真实的人、一个家庭，以及一个战火仍在持续的国家。

cues.en: That was Ukrainian tennis player Diana Yastremska speaking to the BBC.
cues.zh: 以上是乌克兰网球运动员达雅娜·雅斯特雷姆斯卡接受 BBC 采访的内容。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now. If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 今天的节目就到这里。欢迎发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk 与我们联系。

cues.en: You can also watch our episodes in full. Just search for the Global News Podcast on YouTube.
cues.zh: 你也可以在 YouTube 搜索《Global News Podcast》，观看完整节目。

cues.en: This edition was produced by Marion Strawn. The editor is Karen Martin. I'm Charlotte Gallagher. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 本期由玛丽安·斯特朗制作，编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是夏洛特·加拉格尔。下期再见。
